changes.text: 于是有了那个读完忘不掉的细节：金币被扔掉，照片被留下；他还从王后赠给船、内有她亲笔字迹的那本圣经上撕下扉页。
And so the detail that stays with you: "sovereigns were thrown away and photographs were kept." He tore the fly-leaf out of the Bible the Queen had given to the ship, with her own writing in it.
苦干四天之后的第二天，天冷而平静，还是那种湿雪。他看清，以眼下松软的雪面，加上四天苦干换来的那点成果，走不了多远；他同时也考虑到，附近有可能开出水道，那样就能划船向西北方向去找陆地。两方面的考虑合起来指向同一个决定——找一块更结实的浮冰扎营，等条件更有利时再做第二次挣脱冰牢的尝试。

The next day, after four days of hard effort, broke cold and still, with the same wet snow. In the clearing light he could see the situation plainly. With the surface as loose as it was, and given how little they had to show for four days of strenuous effort, they would never get any great distance. And there was a second possibility to weigh: leads might open close to them, which would let them row north-west to where they might find land. The two considerations pointed one way. He decided to find a more solid floe, camp there, and stay until conditions were more favourable for a second attempt to escape from their icy prison.
一种解释是（作者推断），海洋营不是他第一次决定停下。行军第二天早上，雪大得看不清路，他就决定不拔营；天晴一些后探到一块好走的浮冰，午饭后又继续走。两次决定都在衡量眼前的路还能不能走下去。海洋营的不同在于，这一次他把等待写成了一个计划：营地选在更结实的浮冰上，理由里挂着一个具体的指望——附近可能开出水道，那时可以划船去找陆地——等条件更有利，再做第二次尝试。

One reading, and it is the author's, is that Ocean Camp was not the first time he chose to stop. On the march's second morning, with snow too thick to see a path, he decided not to strike camp; when it cleared and a good floe turned up, they moved on after lunch. Both decisions turned on whether the way ahead could be made. What set Ocean Camp apart is that this time he wrote the waiting down as a plan. The camp went onto a more solid floe, the reasoning carried a specific hope (leads opening nearby, boats in the water, land to the north-west), and a second attempt was to follow once conditions improved.

dispositions.rationale: 原文的“with her own writing in it”修饰圣经，不能断定字迹就在被撕下的扉页上。中文改为“内有她亲笔字迹的那本圣经”，英文改回原文措辞“with her own writing in it”，不再声称字迹在那一页上。

evidence.quote: I tore the fly-leaf out of the Bible that Queen Alexandra had given to the ship, with her own writing in it,

dispositions.rationale: 中文原把可能开出水道也算作他“看清”的事。现改为：他看清的只有雪面松软、成果太少、走不远；水道是他“同时也考虑到”的一种可能。“两件事”相应改为“两方面的考虑”，与英文的“a second possibility to weigh”和“The two considerations”一致。英文原本无误，按规则原样给出。

evidence.quote: I could see that with the present loose surface
Taking into account also the possibility of leads opening close to us

dispositions.rationale: “值不值得把船带进去冒险”只是不拔营那次的理由，海洋营那次的理由里没有。现删去这一点，中英文统一改为两次决定都在衡量前路还能不能走下去。这一点两段记述都支持：一次是找路困难，一次是走不了多远。

evidence.quote: A path over the shattered floes would be hard to find, and to get the boats into a position of peril might be disastrous
it would be impossible to proceed for any great distance
